issue.title: Improve SDLC PR titles and descriptions

acceptance_criteria.description: [TASK-1-1] JSON schema validates contracts with and without PR metadata, nullable for backward compatibility
[TASK-1-2] Models match schema, existing contracts without `pr` field validate successfully
[TASK-2-1] ParseResult can store extracted PR metadata
[TASK-2-2] Parser correctly extracts PR metadata when present, returns None when absent
[TASK-2-3] Tests cover present, absent, and malformed PR metadata cases
[TASK-3-1] Contract JSON includes PR metadata when present in plan, omitted when absent
[TASK-3-2] Long titles generate a warning in parse output
[TASK-4-1] Template shows example PR title and description format
[TASK-4-2] Prompt explicitly asks for concise, context-rich PR title and description
[TASK-5-1] PR uses contract metadata when present, falls back to current behavior when absent
[TASK-5-2] Final PR title matches contract, or falls back to issue title
[TASK-5-3] Comment appears with clear formatting, editable by reviewer
